description: HOH, one qualifying child, earned income exactly $12,730 — maximum EIC.
derivation: Official 2025 EIC table (i1040gi--2025.pdf, sha256 482e9c487c608f1bbeaceef35bc3c0933e8b35443cfff447e4279d590468364a) row $12,700–$12,750 for one child, not joint, prints $4,328. That row contains the $12,730 earned-income amount, so the table prints the statutory maximum rather than the $12,725 midpoint ($4,327). Evidence: extracted cell other/1 at lo=12700 in tests/engine/eicTable2025.json.
